paperTitle: PRTS: A Primitive Reasoning and Tasking System via Contrastive Representations
organization: Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom / Tsinghua University / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Fudan University

benchmarks.label: LIBERO
benchmarks.detail: Suites: libero spatial 98.8 · libero object 99.8 · libero goal 98.4 · libero long 96.6 | Table 2 | Notes: Four standard LIBERO suites. PRTS is post-trained with global batch size 32 for 30K gradient steps.

benchmarks.label: LIBERO-Plus
benchmarks.detail: Suites: camera 59.5 · robot 72.4 · language 89.6 · light 96.5 · background 96.7 · noise 81.3 · layout 83.3 | Table 3 | Notes: Zero-shot robustness evaluation on 10,030 LIBERO-Plus test tasks using the checkpoint post-trained only on standard LIBERO.

benchmarks.label: LIBERO-Pro
benchmarks.detail: Suites: semantic 97.0 · object 82.3 · position 24.3 · task 31.5 | Table 4 | Notes: Zero-shot generalization evaluation using the LIBERO-finetuned checkpoint. The paper explicitly omits the Environment perturbation because official assets were not yet released.

benchmarks.label: SimplerEnv
benchmarks.detail: Suites: WidowX visual matching 77.1 | Tasks: put spoon on towel 83.3 · put carrot on plate 66.6 · stack green block on yellow block 58.3 · put eggplant in yellow basket 100.0 | Table 5 | Notes: SimplerEnv BridgeData V2/WidowX track; PRTS is post-trained on BridgeData V2 with global batch size 1024 for 20K gradient steps.
